turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good morning, Marcus! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend starting off over in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! It's starting off pretty well. I just finished making a protein smoothie for breakfast, and now I'm trying to get organized for the day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A protein smoothie is a great way to fuel up. Do you have any big plans lined up for today, or are you keeping things low-key?

turns.text: I'm actually heading out in about half an hour to meet up with a friend for a tennis workout. It's a bit brisk outside, but it should be perfect once we get moving.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a fantastic way to spend a Saturday morning! I hope you have a great match. Is Grace joining you on the court today?

turns.text: Not today, she has a few errands to run this morning. But we are planning to sit down later this afternoon to talk about our Japan trip.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, exciting! Have you two made any more decisions about the itinerary for next spring, or are you still in the brainstorming phase?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Still mostly brainstorming, but we're starting to look at specific cities. We definitely want to spend a good chunk of time in Tokyo and Kyoto, so we're looking at train routes between them.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Those are both incredible cities with so much to see. Planning the travel logistics can be half the fun! Do you think you'll have any time for your woodworking projects this weekend too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I hope so. If I'm not too tired after tennis and trip planning, I'd love to spend an hour or two in the garage sanding down some boards for a new shelf I'm working on.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very productive and satisfying Saturday. Good luck with your tennis workout, and enjoy the woodworking later if you get to it!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm going to grab my gear and head out now. Talk to you later!
